name: Super Orbmaster
storyline: Our main man Barp Squalton was spending his evening avoiding interacting with his neighbors by hiking through the woods. Suddenly he tripped and fell into a deep hole. What he couldn't have expected however, was that this hole lead to the mysterious Sage Expo. To make matters worse, it turns out one of the only people attending the expo is the annoying local merchant Sylvia. Before Barp can leave the expo, the Sage running the event manages to convince him to try out... The Sage Challenges.
summary: Barp may not be able to run fast, curl into a ball, or cure his hair loss, but he does have one thing that sets him apart from other precision platformer characters. During the Sage Challenges, Barp has access to an orb, this orb is the only way he can deal any damage to any of the enemies found in the levels. It can also be used to interact with certain stage elements, as well as defend Barp from projectile attacks. It's so important that you cannot progress to other rooms without having the orb in your possession.
